title: The basement?
content: Anyone remember water and weird stairs going into a basement and there was water like a foot of water you’d walk through and there was a bed and tv in the water? Was this part of Mall World or was this in Disney World? I’ve been trying to remember more but it’s hard since I’m not fully awake like I was when I was a kid (I was in GATE and STARGATE!) and I actually enjoyed working for the agency
